create_prometheus_logger: create a PrometheusLogger instance to emit LiteLLM proxy metrics to Prometheus
initialize_budget_metrics_cron_job: initialize a cron job that refreshes remaining budget metrics for all teams, keys, users, and orgs
mount_metrics_endpoint: mount the Prometheus /metrics ASGI endpoint on the LiteLLM proxy application
build_prometheus_labels: build a dictionary of sanitized Prometheus label names and values from request metadata
get_custom_labels_from_tags: get custom Prometheus labels from request tags using exact match and wildcard pattern matching
